name: Example Profile - arXiv Edge AI Classification

parameters.query:
WITH new_job AS (
  INSERT INTO classification_jobs (
    id,
    profile_id,
    input_payload_json,
    source_url,
    reference_url,
    run_mode,
    status,
    created_at,
    updated_at
  )
  VALUES (
    '{{$json.jobId}}',
    '{{$json.profileIdSql}}',
    '{{$json.inputPayloadSql}}'::jsonb,
    '{{$json.sourceUrlSql}}',
    '{{$json.referenceUrlSql}}',
    '{{$json.runModeSql}}',
    'prepared',
    NOW(),
    NOW()
  )
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO classification_results (
  job_id,
  category,
  confidence,
  evidence,
  provider,
  model,
  raw_response_json,
  created_at
)
SELECT
  id,
  'cp5_prepared',
  NULL,
  '{{$json.payloadSummarySql}}',
  'cp5_prep',
  'none',
  '{{$json.payloadJsonSql}}'::jsonb,
  NOW()
FROM new_job
RETURNING job_id;

WITH updated AS (
  UPDATE classification_jobs
  SET status = 'completed',
      error_message = NULL,
      updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = '{{$json.jobIdSql}}'
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO classification_results (
  job_id,
  category,
  confidence,
  evidence,
  provider,
  model,
  raw_response_json,
  created_at
)
SELECT
  id,
  'edge_ai_batch',
  NULL,
  '{{$json.summarySql}}',
  '{{$json.providerSql}}',
  '{{$json.modelNameSql}}',
  '{{$json.rawResultSql}}'::jsonb,
  NOW()
FROM updated
RETURNING job_id;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { "jobId": $json.job_id, "status": "completed", "pipeline": "arxiv_edge_ai_example", "classifiedCount": $node["Parse + Prepare Save"].json.classifiedCount, "positiveCount": $node["Parse + Prepare Save"].json.positiveCount, "negativeCount": $node["Parse + Prepare Save"].json.negativeCount } }}
